display_long_description:
🎮 *Game Overview*: SXM Demo is a sneak peak to Stunt X Mania VR Motocross Freestyle Bike game. Have you ever wondered if you could go crazy and perform insane motocross and stunts at home? We bring to you hyper-realistic bike controls like you've never experienced before! 

🏁 *Key Features*

- Enjoy a new hyper-realistic vehicle control system, with engaging clutch and gear mechanics and crazy jumps!

🕹️ *Game Modes*

- *Free Roam* -  No-holds barred, master your motocross bike skills without thinking of running out of time! 2 Tracks to Ride and Stunt.

-*Stunt* -  
     Basic Stunt - Wheele | Endos | 360 Back & Front Flip added in Demo.
      Mid-Air Stunt -  Special Flip | Cliffhanger.

-*Gear Sytem*-  Mannual gear shift using Clutch | Auto Gear.

Enjoy Career Mode | Challenege Mode | 12 FMX Stunts | Bike & Avatar Customisation in the Paid Version Stunt X Mania.

Multiplayer is the Next Update Cooming Soon.

Challenge Mode Is avilable to buy in Demo Vrsion and Enjoy all the Challeneges Map
